verdict.rationale: A game framework with an editor and agent tooling could plausibly offer event-triggered rules or automations, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents any capability for defining rules that fire actions automatically on events. The unified input system, scenes and the MCP agent tools are adjacent features and do not evidence an event-rule or trigger mechanism.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
